statement_map.email_excerpt: You came with a list of topics, including your thank-you page, the mobile layout of your landing page, emails going to spam, your invoices, unlocking lessons weekly and exporting your student list.
Following our guidance, you pasted your thank-you page link into the redirect field in your product's After purchase settings, and your test order now goes to your thank-you page.
Following our guidance, you increased the spacing between the two buttons in the mobile view of your page editor, and you confirmed on your phone that they are now separate and look fine.
We explained how to verify your email domain: add your domain in Email settings, add the three DNS records you receive at your domain registrar, then click Verify.
This is not yet resolved. (email domain)
We explained that if you decide to extend your expired coupon, you can change its expiry date in the coupon settings.
You told us the GST name on your invoices shows your personal name, not your company name.
This is not yet resolved. (GST name)
We explained that there is a drip schedule setting for lessons, but we are not sure whether it works when a course is sold inside a bundle, as yours is.
This is not yet resolved. (drip schedule)
We are not aware of an AI quiz generator being available right now and do not have a date for one, so please do not plan around it.
Get your developer to add the three DNS records at your domain registrar (by Friday, as you mentioned).
Once the records are added, click Verify in your email settings.
Try exporting your student list: go to Students, click Export and choose CSV.
